registries.why: The first Robinhood generation left both unset, so LaunchFactory skipped the creator cooldown, tier, live-count and wallet-cluster checks that BNB enforces and that Solana enforces on chain (TIER_COOLDOWN_SECONDS 86400, tiers 3/5/10). Added after deployment, while the factory was still paused and not live. Both registries are owned by the deployer, which is what lets the factory be registered as a launch recorder.

lpLocker.how: timelocked: the router already authorized the previous generation's locker 0x9523d856, so propose -> upgradeDelay (3600s) -> accept
lpLocker.why: PermanentV3PositionLocker routes the protocol's 20% of every LP harvest through routeLpToken behind authorizedLpLocker and parks it silently on refusal. Unauthorized, the first graduation would have paid the creator and stranded the protocol share, as BSC testnet did.

harvest.split: exactly 80/20 into the protocol vault on the harvest itself

acceptance.firstRunNote: The first run passed through graduation and the V3 lock, then died in the harness: RobinhoodV3NativeSwapAdapter gained a deadline argument in the audit and the harness still passed the old 5-arg shape. The chain was fine; the harness was fixed and re-run.
acceptance.creatorsNote: Re-run used two throwaway creator wallets funded with 0.01 from the testnet deployer (0x9Da9D84F… and 0xcc887fE6…), because the first run's creators had just launched and the registry's 24h cooldown -- now enforced on this chain -- would have refused them. Keys live only in the session scratchpad.
